title: Rebel Jesus – a Christmas carol
excerpt: I’ve been a Jackson Browne fan since college. I opened a chapter of EMC with reflections on a Christmas song by this classic songwriter who says, “I bid you pleasure and I bid you cheer from a heathen and a pagan on the side of the rebel Jesus.”
